title: Negotiation: they anchor, then go quiet

setup.objective: Hold price; trade term length for discount only
avoid: Conceding price and term at once

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: We've looked at the proposal. Honestly, at four hundred and twenty thousand a year it's hard for us. We were thinking closer to three hundred.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: We also need the first ninety days free to cover migration, and a thirty day out clause.

moments.note: Do not counter immediately; expose constraints or let the silence work.
They stacked three asks (price, free period, out clause). Identify the real variable; don't concede several at once.
